name: whatsapp_reply
description: Sends a text message from the user's WhatsApp to a contact whose role allows replies, and checks that WhatsApp's server received it; the person gets it at once. Use it only after showing the user the exact text and getting a yes. For any other role, no role or a group it refuses and sends nothing. It reads no messages (that is whatsapp_chats). If the same text went out recently it is not sent again; never call it twice for the same message. Returns one line confirming the send.

contact.description: Number with country code as whatsapp_chats shows it (e.g. +15551234567).

message.description: The exact text the user approved, with nothing added (e.g. "Hi Clara, I will send the quote tomorrow.").

examples.message: Hi Clara, I will send the quote tomorrow.
